main.CODE: chart-history, chart-rebased, chart-cvl, kpi:level, kpi:crops, kpi:livestock — selects the general index, the index without hired labour, crops and livestock
main.NAME_HE: chart-rebased — CBS's label, shown for a code the recipe has no short label for
main.FREQ: skip: constant M (fetched monthly only); rows of any other frequency are dropped
main.TIME_PERIOD: skip: the same month as DATE in another form
main.DATE: chart-recent, chart-history, chart-annual, chart-rebased, chart-cvl, chart-heat, insight:season
main.VALUE: recent, kpi:level — the published value on its own base
main.BASE_DESC: recent, kpi:level — the base each published value is on
main.PERCENT_YEAR: chart-recent, chart-annual, chart-cvl, kpi:yoy, kpi:crops, kpi:livestock, insight:yoy_trend, insight:crops_livestock
main.VALUE_CHAINED: chart-history, chart-rebased, insight:decades, insight:crops_livestock — every month on the newest base
main.CHAIN_BASE: chart-history — names the base of the chained series
groups_a.CODE: chart-drivers, chart-decade, groups, chart-rebased — hired labour (260450) also joins the rebased view
groups_a.FREQ: skip: constant M (fetched monthly only); rows of any other frequency are dropped
groups_a.TIME_PERIOD: skip: the same month as DATE in another form
groups_a.VALUE: skip: shown as changes only; levels across bases come from VALUE_CHAINED
groups_a.BASE_DESC: skip: shown as changes only, so the base of each published value is not needed
groups_a.CHAIN_BASE: skip: shown as changes or rebased to 100, so the base name is not shown
